player_prompt.intro:
A na wá {N} agbajọ to ma wà lẹgbẹẹ.
To kọjọ ṣẹṣẹ, tẹ [accept] nado wá ọjọ to wà lọsu, tẹbi [continue] nado kọjọ ọjọ to ma wà lẹgbẹẹ.
To bẹ kọjọ ṣẹṣẹ, a na gbọja wá ọjọ to gbẹ.
A na sẹ (gbẹjọ = 1) **nikan** to bẹ wá ọjọ he ogbẹ wá lọsu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nǔwiwa ɔ ɖó na nyí [accept] alǒ [continue].

outcome.summary: Mi xɛ̀ɖe si {value} to dɔ̀wɔ̀ {draw_num}/{N}. Mɛ̀ gbaɖe ɖɔ lɔ {best}. {result}
outcome.perfect: Nǔ e è sɔ́ ɖó vo é nɛ!
